purpose: Records when features were introduced, with the source for each claim and an explicit confidence, so per-version enable/disable decisions cite evidence instead of memory. A boundary with no source is NOT recorded here as fact.

evidenceStandard.primary: A hash-verified client jar for the version in question. Strongest, and used wherever a jar is available and published by Mojang.
evidenceStandard.secondary: The Minecraft Wiki's per-block History section, which cites Notch's own changelist posts for the early versions. Used where no jar extraction exists yet, and marked as secondary.
evidenceStandard.rule: Unknown stays unknown. A plausible boundary from memory is never recorded as evidence, because a wrong boundary either admits later content into an early world or removes content the version had, and both are invisible.

boundaries.feature: grass (the plant; modern id minecraft:short_grass, pre-1.13 block id 31 named 'tallgrass')

source.supportingQuote: Prior to The Flattening, the block's numeral ID was 31, with metadata 1.
source.crossCheck: This project's own b1.7.3 extraction lists 'tallgrass' among the 83 block names read from the hash-verified b1.7.3 client, which is consistent with the block existing by 1.7.3 and with the wiki's pre-1.13 name.

boundaries.consequence: Alpha v1.1.2_01 and both Infdev builds must place no grass. Moderner Beta places ModernBetaVegetationPlacedFeatures.PATCH_GRASS_ALPHA_2 (registry id moderner_beta:patch_grass_alpha_2) in those versions' biomes, so it is excluded for them.
boundaries.implementedAs: HistoricalFeatureExclusions.BEFORE_GRASS_EXISTED, applied by revision 1 of historical_experience:alpha, historical_experience:infdev_420 and historical_experience:infdev_611
boundaries.verifiedBy: A 289-chunk Alpha world generated on revision 1 contains no grass plant and 31,531 grass BLOCKS, which is correct: the block existed, the plant did not.

source.detail: Vines are absent from the 83 block names extracted from the hash-verified b1.7.3 client (checked: 'vine' is not in the set), and the Beta 1.8.1 boundary is what this project already records for endermen, cave spiders, silverfish and XP orbs.

boundaries.consequence: Vines must not appear in Infdev, Alpha or Beta 1.7.3.
boundaries.observedDefect: A 289-chunk Alpha world on revision 1 contains 10 vine blocks. The block-suppression hook cannot remove them because it decides from a version's EXTRACTED BLOCK PALETTE, and only Beta 1.7.3 has one; Alpha and Infdev fall back to making no claim.
boundaries.nextStep: Replace the palette-only decision with a block-introduction table covering every version, so an anachronistic block is suppressed wherever it is placed rather than only on versions whose palette has been extracted.

openGaps: Alpha and Infdev have no extracted block palette of their own. The b1.7.3 extraction tool parses their jars (474/474 Alpha classes parse to the exact last byte) but cannot find a block class by name, because those versions do not load plain block-name strings the way Beta 1.7.3 does. The Alpha jar is hash-verified and present, so this is a tooling gap, not a provenance one.
Structure introduction boundaries for Beta 1.8.1 and later are not yet recorded, so no structure rule is declared for those versions and none is enforced.
